Nina (Head of Product Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — customers asked for a clear, short timeline for Hosted API streaming fixes, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations. Can we give a customer-facing summary + any hard blockers?
Lee (VP Product): Quick summary for customers: Hosted API streaming -> targeted GA window: late July 2026 (staged); Console cost visuals -> public beta mid-August 2026; Optimize recommendations -> invite-only beta Sept 2026. Blockers: perf regressions, billing event schema, and metrics retention.
Nina (Head of Product Ops): Can we call out who to cc for notices and who owns the blockers? Sales and CS need a contact list.
Omar (Eng-Infra): Perf blockers owners: kernel perf/regression -> Keiko's infra team; memory regression on long-context streaming -> Tara (not on this thread). I can own the canary infra and rollout windows.
Keiko (Eng-ML): Confirming kernel regression owner. Current plan: patch + validation in staging, then a 48h canary. If canary meets p99 and memory SLOs we'll expand.
Rina (Optimize PM): For Optimize we need 30 days of stable eval metrics and a privacy signoff for per-customer comparisons. I'll send the waiver to legal and beta customers.
Carmen (Customer Success): For private deployments customers expect 30-45 days notice. Also ask: will we require any client-side changes for GA? This affects account outreach.
Lee (VP Product): No forced client-side changes for GA. We will use server-side feature flags where possible and a documented deprecation path for any breaking changes (60-day beta + migration examples).
docs-bot: Reminder: publish alpha docs (docs.redwood.ai/alpha) with a clear "not GA" banner and migration snippets.
Nina (Head of Product Ops): Canary schedule request — Omar, can you confirm dates and opt-in percentage so PMs can tell customers?
Omar (Eng-Infra): Proposed canary: 2026-06-28 -> 2026-06-30 UTC, 2% opt-in traffic. Includes tracing, automatic rollback at p99 > 2x baseline, and memory alerts.
Keiko (Eng-ML): Add: we'll gate GA on p99 latency regressions <5% and memory usage not exceeding baseline by more than 10% in 95% of runs.
Rina (Optimize PM): For Console cost visuals early access, beta customers need the eval metrics and retention in place. If they opt-in we'll surface cost-breakdowns in a private beta tab. Legal review required for any cross-customer comparisons.
Carmen (Customer Success): I'll draft the customer notices: one for hosted customers (14-day opt-in notice), one for private customers (30-day notice + opt-in form). I'll share templates in #customer-comm.
Lee (VP Product): Docs + SDKs: Samira and DevEx will publish alpha examples; SDK maintainers please freeze breaking changes during the beta window. We'll tag SDK owners in the release PRs.
Jon (CEO): Two asks: keep external messaging conservative (use "target" months) and ensure account teams have a clear opt-in path for early access. Also avoid shipping anything that could degrade SLAs for paying customers.
Nina (Head of Product Ops): Action list: Omar to confirm canary window + runbook; Keiko to post gating metrics; Rina to circulate privacy waiver; Carmen to prepare notice templates; docs-bot to publish alpha docs banner. I'll compile a one-page customer timeline and send to #product by EOD Friday.
Lee (VP Product): Agreed. I'll also update the public roadmap blurb to "target month + gating criteria" and share a conservative and optimistic timeline for Sales.
Keiko (Eng-ML): Small heads-up: billing event schema change required for Console cost visuals aggregation. Alex (billing) will open the PR; must be backwards-compatible externally.
Omar (Eng-Infra): Will add tracing hooks to the canary and a rollout dashboard. I'll post the runbook link once it's live.
Nina (Head of Product Ops): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the compiled timeline and the action tracker. :white_check_mark:
